446358.overview: UXB is a single screen game where you play the role of Captain Dar-es UXB, a bomb disposal expert who has been called to save the Caverns of Time. Gaterns have placed bombs in each cavern because they weren't given immortality by Lord of the Touchstone and vow to destroy them all. You must move around the screen, touching four of the bombs to defuse them before each bomb's timers run out, then you touch a Hour Gate to move to the next cavern. If you defuse more than four bombs then the Hour Gate's won't open and you have to sacrifice a life to move to the next cavern.

446380.overview: You are standing in a market with some money and your quest is to buy items before leaving the market into the big bad world to make more money and return back to the market. You will encounter various locations like jungle, swamp and desert as well as alligators, bandits, pythons, etc and these will try to decrease your strength until you die. The screen has text to describe each location, how much money you have and your strength, and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.
